about.title: An independent magazine for curious readers
about.description: Infotaktik is an independent online magazine covering technology, business, culture and modern life through analysis, stories and practical advice.
about.lead: We believe good journalism starts with curiosity. Every week we look for the stories that explain how the world really works — without hurry, without sensationalism and without compromise.
about.introTitle: An editorial team that believes in context
about.intro: Infotaktik began with a simple idea: to give readers a place where they can find clear, verified and thoroughly researched stories. We do not chase clicks — we chase understanding.
about.introSecondary: Our team is made up of editors, journalists and contributors who treat every topic responsibly. Every article goes through editorial review, and we choose our sources carefully and transparently.
about.missionQuote: To turn everyday topics into clear stories that give the reader context, perspective and knowledge they can actually use.
about.valuesDescription: Three principles shape every piece we publish — from a short news item to a long-form analysis.
about.value1Description: Editorial decisions are never for sale. We shape our coverage around readers’ interests, not advertisers’ interests.
about.value2Description: We verify sources, seek out more than one side of the story and correct mistakes openly and without delay.
about.value3Description: News without context is just noise. That is why we explain the background, the consequences and the connections others skip.
about.offerTitle: A magazine to read without hurry
about.offerDescription: From weekly analysis to practical guides — our content is organised so you can find it easily and understand it even more easily.

offerItems.community: Community engagement through comments and discussions
offerItems.categories: Categories to help you discover content you love
offerItems.writers: A platform for both established and emerging writers

about.standardsDescription: Transparency is not a slogan. These are the rules we work by every day.
about.standard1: We clearly separate facts, analysis and the author’s opinion.
about.standard2: We publish corrections openly, explaining what changed and why.
about.standard3: Paid or sponsored content is always clearly labelled.
about.join: Whether you read, write or simply love a good story, you are welcome here. Get in touch with a topic idea, a question or a collaboration.
